title: Lily
description: Yilin bumps into the tomboy Rouxi, sparking an interest between each other that slowly blooms.
author: Lily Club (橘姬社), y神

title: Ryuu: Ron
description:
Kyōto, April 1928. Oshikouji Ryu is 17 years old, and is known as a Kendō prodigy, the 'Dragon of Kyōto'. He will inherit the property of the noble Oshikouji family, but prefers practicing Kendō. He enters Busen, the most renown martial arts school in the country, but his senpai are harsh and intolerable. But Ryu doesn't surrender and overcomes the problems, later on he impresses his senpai and they begin to like him.

This manga tells a great story against the richly textured background of historical Japan and China with refined and excellent artwork. Murakami's views on Chinese and Korean people is very warm, and not those of the previous invader and governor such as the extreme right party in Japan. Another interesting part of the manga is its rich depiction of Japanese colorful life. A typical example of the realistic style and a manga of high reputation in Korea and Japan.
author: Murakami Motoka

title: The Hand of Zeus
description: The story revolves around 6 young criminals held in a youth training center. One day a mysterious man appears from the wall who finds himself wounded and entrusts them with a "hand" which is called the hand of Zeus who harbors a mysterious power and energy. This hand can create a "Mouth" that is like a portal to be transported anywhere which they use to be able to escape the correctional room however having in their possession that hand is a great danger since strange beings are after it so they will have to face them.
author: Kagetsu Jin

title: Kitakubu Katsudou Kiroku
description: When a friend asks Natsuki what high school club she's going to join, she cheerfully responds "the go-home club" (meaning, she's not going to join any of them). However, she soon realizes that this club actually exists at her high school, and she's just expressed interest in joining it! Before she knows it, she ends up as one of the two new members of "the go-home club," which is a small group of eccentric school girls. One of the girls likes fighting bears, while another is ridiculously rich. But what exactly constitutes the activities of "the go-home club"?
author: Kuroha

title: In the Heavenly Prison, the Devil Enchants Me
description: Kaoru Jahana, a boy who aspires to become a true man, begins his high school life on a solitary island in the sea. There, he meets a charming girl, Kanra, who is actually a demon who feeds on men's spirits... and it turns out that all the women on this island are the same demons!?
author: Gingami Meteor

title: Sugar² Rune
description:
From Del Rey:  
Little witch-girls Chocolat and Vanilla are best friends, but only one of them can be Queen of the Magic World. To determine who deserves the title, they must go to the Human World and enter a strange competition. Whoever attracts the most human boys wins! The girls had planned to be best friends forever, but both of them want to be Queen. Will their rivalry ruin their friendship?  
  
---
- **Won the Kodansha Manga Award for Children in 2005**
author: Anno Moyoco

title: Worst Gaiden Mr. Zetton
description: After years of studying, Hanazawa Saburou, AKA Suzuran's legendary Zetton, has finally become a high school teacher. But on his first day at work, the principal tells him he was actually hired not to teach, but to make the students of his homeroom class drop out of school?!
author: Takahashi Hiroshi (高橋ヒロシ), Suzuki Dai

title: I'm in Love with the Villainess
description:
Ordinary office worker Oohashi Rei wakes up in the body of the protagonist of her favourite otome game, *Revolution*. To her delight, the first person to greet her is also her favourite character, Claire François – the main antagonist of the story!

Now, Rei is determined to romance Claire instead of the game’s male leads. But how will her villainous lady love react to this new courtship?!
author: Inori.

title: Something small and cute
description: Follow the adventures of Chiikawa the innocent cute creature, Hachiware the kind cat, and Usagi the chaotic rabbit as they work their hardest to survive in a world filled with dangerous monsters, mysterious armored taskmasters, and fantastical phenomena at every turn!
author: Nagano

title: Morino-san Just Won't Leave Me Be
description: Morino-san is laid-back about everything, but languid as she is, she just won't leave me be.
author: Barako

title: Tsukimichi: Moonlit Fantasy
description:
High school student Misumi Makoto is called into a fantasy world by the god Tsukuyomi, in order to be a hero. However, powerful others in this world aren't as thrilled to have him there, and they kick him to the edge of the world just as Tsukuyomi declares that he must leave Makoto to find his own way. Now it's up to Makoto to find his own way!
___
[Official English Light Novel](https://hanashi.media/series/tsukimichi/)
author: Azumi Kei

title: Bocchi the Rock! Side Story: Hiroi Kikuri's Heavy Drinking Diary
description:
25 years old Kikuri Hiroi is a "genius bassist" who leads the indie band "SICK HACK" and loves alcohol. 
She often gets drunk and breaks the equipment inside concert clubs, so she's often short of money. 
Living in a 52-year-old bathless apartment sometimes forces her to borrow showers from her friends. 
Regularly attacked by anxiety about her future, she counters that with a alcohol-fueled "happiness spiral". 
What is her daily life like...!?
author: Kumichou

title: Juumonji in Sight!
description:
Asahi Nishizono has finally made her high school debut. But ever since she was a little girl, she's never been able to forget her first love, You Kazami. Even now, she can't take her eyes off his handsome face...

...or so she thought, until a huge shadow suddenly blocks her view.

“WHOA! JUUMONJI?!”

That's Touya Juumonji, Kazami's childhood friend who's always by his side. Not only is he huge, he's also ridiculously talented at all sorts of things. And somehow, Juumonji always manages to steal Nishizono's view of Kazami...?!
author: Itsutsuse

title: Will You Give Me Your First Time?
description:
Miyuki works as a receptionist and is secretly dating Chiba, the vice president's secretary who is popular with everyone at the company. He is flawless in both appearance and behavior, yet he never makes a move on her, leaving her frustrated and impatient.

Unable to wait any longer, Miyuki decides to sneak into his bed at night—only to discover that the seemingly perfect Chiba is actually a virgin. She is thrilled by the gap between his composed exterior and his shy, flustered reaction.

Excited, she keeps teasing him until he suddenly turns the tables, declaring that he will give her plenty in return. His gentle yet intense caresses melt her whole body until she can hardly stay conscious.

As their secret office romance heats up, Miyuki cannot help but wonder: can this really be his first time?
author: Aizawa Miki (藍沢ミキ)

title: Hino Hideshi's Doraemon
description: Horror Mangaka Hino Hideshi puts Nobita and Doraemon through hell to take revenge on Gian.
author: Hino Hideshi

title: .A -dot Alice-
description: High school Second year Izumi is surrounded by girls that are a little peculiar: Haughty rich girl Shinonome and gamer junior Akaishi. Even his childhood friend and a transfer student turn up out of nowhere. It is the early 2000s. A nostalgic, heartwarming romance that tickles your memories of "those days" begins now!
author: Nishio Takuya

title: Audio record log at 5AM
description: Ban Kuregata possesses ears that are acutely sensitive to sound. Because of this, the passing years have left him with scarcely any peaceful memories. That is, until Hino Shinonome appeared—the first person to tenderly embrace and treasure his uniqueness. Could her invitation to weave animated films together gently unfold a new chapter in Ban's life...?
author: No Kyou

title: Date or Kill: Secret Matching
description:
Ayame, a top-notch assassin who has lived 25 years without any connection to romance, is convinced by a colleague to register on a dating app—while hiding her true identity!
She ends up matching with none other than her next target: Murai, the ruthless and cold-hearted young leader of a gang...!?
author: Hitsujiya Aku

title: No More Eurydice
description:
Han Garam enrolls a prestigious arts university at the heart of Korea’s classical music scene, an institution that has produced world-renowned musicians.

His academic advisor, Professor Kim Heejae, a world-famous pianist, exploits Han Garam’s passion for his own ambition…

“what you hold dearest will become your greatest pain.”
author: Baek Daekal

title: Kimi no Ashiato wa Barairo
description: Haruka and Takumi had their bodies swapped when they fell down a staircase at a shrine. After several years of searching for a way to go back to normal, they find themselves increasingly aware of each other as their physical sex…
author: Sengoku Hiroko
